events.speaker: customer
events.text: The dishwasher is in the basement, with water leaking right now.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: My partner says it stopped this morning, but I saw water under it just now. I cannot tell whether there is still an active leak. Saturday morning works for me, and I want a quote before any work.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: I checked again: there is no leak now. Correction: I do not need a quote before the repair after all. Saturday morning still works.
